description: Find where a football team's upcoming matches (or a specific match like 'Arsenal v Chelsea') are shown live in a given country, with the kickoff in local time, the licensed channel or stream, verified subscription prices where known, and a link to the full page. Covers the Premier League, La Liga, Serie A, Bundesliga, Ligue 1, Champions League, Europa League, domestic cups and internationals across 100+ countries.

country.description: Country the viewer is in, by name or ISO code, e.g. 'Nigeria', 'US', 'UK'.

query.description: A team ('Liverpool') or a match ('Real Madrid v Barcelona').

timezone.description: Optional IANA time zone for the kickoff, e.g. 'Asia/Dubai'. Defaults to the country's main zone.

name: where_to_watch
title: Where to watch a team or match
